Subject: Co-hosted webinar: Catalyst x Redwood — invite plan & staggered reminders

Hi Tara + events team,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the August 18 webinar (Scaling Inference: balancing latency & cost). I put together a lightweight invite plan and a staggered reminder cadence so we can seed Catalyst audiences alongside our own warm list. Goal is 300 registrants with 25% engineer/architect mix and 15% decision-maker attendance.

High-level plan attached: invite_copy_v1.docx (email copy + 3 subject lines) and tracking_links-sheet.csv (seed lists + UTM mapping). Key asks for your team:
- Confirm co-branding assets (logo + color margins) — I see a logo file would be helpful.
- Approve the primary subject line and 2 reminder snippets.
- Confirm which Catalyst segments you want us to target (dev community vs enterprise accounts).

Staggered cadence we propose:
1) Invite send (T-21 days) — joint send from Redwood, Catalyst co-sending to partner segments.
2) Reminder A (T-7 days) — technical snippet tailored to engineers.
3) Reminder B (T-1 day) — urgency + speaker bullet points.
4) Day-of short SMS (if Catalyst opts in) — 2 hours prior.

Tracking: each seed segment gets a dedicated UTM + shortlink so we can attribute registrants to Catalyst lists and field. See tracking_links-sheet.csv.

Proposed owner matrix:
- Redwood copy & send cadence: Marissa (copy finalization + send windows)
- Tracking & links: Mateo (shortlink creation + GA/Eventbrite tagging)
- Partner liaison: Olga (coordination + co-send timing)

If you can share the logo ZIP and any partner-specific language by EOD Friday (July 30), we can lock the send cadence and schedule an ops rehearsal for Aug 11.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,
Olga
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invite_copy_v1.docx (copy draft), tracking_links-sheet.csv (UTM mapping, shortlinks), catalyst_logo.zip (requested)
